references.text: Matthew's parallel account of the women who came to the tomb early on the first day of the week: [ref:Matt 28:1|Matthew 28:1].
Mark's parallel account of the women who came to the tomb very early on the first day of the week with fragrant spices: [ref:Mark 16:1-2|Mark 16:1-2].
John's parallel account of Mary Magdalene coming to the tomb early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark: [ref:Joh 20:1|John 20:1].
The women had prepared fragrant spices and ointments before the Sabbath, which they now brought to the tomb: [ref:Luk 23:56|Luke 23:56].
The tomb (μνῆμα) where Joseph of Arimathea laid Jesus' body is the same tomb the women now visit: [ref:Luk 23:53|Luke 23:53].
